title: Senior Software Engineer - Data + AI Observability
description: P-1385 Sr. Software Engineer (L5) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Customer Foresight Team builds products that enable customers to gain insights into their AI and data workloads, optimize performance, and reduce costs. You'll work on data infrastructure processing billions of entries daily, deployed across over 65 cloud regions worldwide, empowering some of the world's largest companies to conduct DevOps, FinOps, SecOps, and AIOps operations. The Impact You Will Have - Design and build scalable systems that provide customers with reliable, timely observability into their Databricks environment. - Lead technical development of product milestones from requirements refinement through execution, operation, and iteration with product and partner teams. - Optimize large-scale data pipelines for performance and cost efficiency, reducing customer costs and enabling new product opportunities. - Build platform capabilities that enable teams across Databricks to publish data to customers efficiently. - Mentor engineers on technical contributions and career development. What We Look For - 5+ years of software engineering experience. - Experience with one or more programming languages including Java, Scala, Python, or C++. - Proven track record architecting, developing, deploying, and operating components of large-scale distributed systems. - Experience with cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or Kubernetes. - Strong engineering practices around security, correctness, and operational excellence. - Platform development experience, including building for internal and external customers and driving adoption through iteration. - Effective cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams. - B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
